PRODUCT OVERVIEW

An integrated foundation.

Avarthana's AMD Processor radar processing system provides a configurable computing platform for radar data handling, application processing and operator display integration. The AMD architecture supports a processor configuration selected for the workload and I/O requirements. High-speed networking, PCIe expansion, serial interfaces and local storage support connection to radar acquisition and control subsystems. Cooling and power implementation are matched to the final system configuration.

Radar computing: AMD Processor platform for application-specific radar data processing.

Memory capacity: 64 GB system-memory target with platform-specific implementation.

Network integration: 1/10/40/100GbE interface targets for radar system connectivity.

PCIe expansion: 22-lane connectivity target; generation and routing configuration-dependent.

Control and display: USB, UART, GPIO and high-resolution display interface provisions.

Thermal integration: Liquid/conduction cooling options and at least two thermal sensors.

System integration

Form factor / mountingDefined per system configuration
